summary: Split 2: native-resolution TTF text in the screen pass
author: pm
body:
Screen-pass TTF rasterises at logical size times `ui_scale` and draws at the inverse scale; measuring, wrapping and layout stay in 800x600 units; one shared baseline snapped to window pixels.

**Done when:** text is sharp at 1440x1080 and wraps exactly as at 800x600; reviewed.

Source: user request 2026-11-23; plan .claude/design/plans/world-screen-split.md.

**Verified, 2026-11-23:** Opus review passed (snap math, alignment, scale test, smoothing toggle, clip, cross-platform); size uses floor to avoid overhang; Debug build 0 errors. Not yet seen in game; check tight right-aligned text at 1440x1080 in Split 5 (HH-0014).
